name: SUPERFUTA ⚡️
source:
Some powers change your life.
Others completely rewrite it.

One moment, everything is normal. The next — you’re thrown into a world you didn’t even know existed. New abilities. New rules. And no time to figure things out.

You’re not alone anymore.

Strange encounters, unexpected allies, and dangerous opponents begin to shape your path. Every step forward pulls you deeper into a hidden side of the city — one where strength, instincts, and choices matter more than ever.

Nothing here is random.

Every fight, every decision, every interaction pushes the story in a different direction. Sometimes it’s about winning. Sometimes it’s about understanding what you’re really up against.

And sometimes… it’s about how far you’re willing to go.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4949150/SUPERFUTA_%EF%B8%8F/]Steam[/url]]
